name: Letta
summary: Platform for stateful agents with memory, identity and the ability to learn over time (formerly MemGPT); terminal UI, App Server, desktop app and Agent SDK.
description: Current source lives in `letta-ai/letta-code` (npm: `@letta-ai/letta-code`); the original `letta-ai/letta` repo now points there and keeps the retired V1 API server on an `archive` branch.
